retrievalProfile.description: Produces a soft-focus 1970s airbrushed portrait featuring a central figure in a cowboy hat integrated with surreal elements like rainbows and stylized flora against a hazy landscape.
triggerTerms: cowboy portrait with rainbow and flowers

recipe.visualDefinition: A central, detailed portrait of a bearded man in a wide-brimmed hat, rendered with soft textures and fine stippling, surrounded by a circular rainbow motif, surreal oversized flowers, and a hazy, pastoral background with a southern plantation house.
coreVisualRelationships: Portrait figure overlapping a circular rainbow graphic
Surreal flora and insects in the foreground
Hazy, atmospheric landscape in the upper right quadrant
Text contained within a curved banner at the top center
coreInvariants: Soft, diffused lighting with no harsh shadows
Fine-grain texture resembling colored pencil over airbrush
Muted, earthy tones contrasted by a vibrant primary-color rainbow

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale portrait positioned slightly left of center, occupying the majority of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The man's face and beard, framed by the hat and the circular rainbow behind him.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the top banner down to the face, following the curve of the rainbow to the flowers in the foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dense central composition with airy, light-colored negative space in the sky and clouds at the bottom.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Earthy browns and tans in the portrait and hat.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant red, orange, yellow, green, and blue in the concentric rainbow rings.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Soft pinks and greens in the floral elements.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the graphic rainbow elements against low-saturation, high-value atmospheric backgrounds.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid pure black in the illustration area

letterConstructionRules: Top name in wide, extended geometric sans-serif with uniform stroke weight
Banner text in a heavy, slab-serif block style following an upward arc
Secondary text in a fluid, slanted brush script
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' in the top name features a horizontal bar that extends to connect with adjacent letters
Script letters have long, tapering flourishes
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between rigid geometric headers, heavy arched block type, and fluid organic script.

preserve: Extended width of the top name

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the wide geometric feel of the top display text
Approximates the heavy, condensed slab-serif in the banner

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an airbrushed illustration of a man with a beard and cowboy hat, a circular rainbow behind him, surreal flowers in the foreground, and a hazy southern landscape in the background, all within a white frame on a black field.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add extended geometric sans-serif text at the top, a curved orange banner with blocky text in the upper center, and a slanted brush script below the banner.

verificationChecks: Is the portrait texture soft and stippled?
Does the rainbow form a perfect circle behind the subject?
Is the top text significantly wider than it is tall?
Is the banner text following a clear upward arc?

mustRedesign: Exact facial likeness of the original subject
postGenerationChecks: Check for soft stippled texture in the skin and hat
Ensure the rainbow rings are concentric and vibrant
Verify the text is correctly placed in the top border and banner
Confirm the background landscape is hazy and atmospheric
recipe.reuseFormula: 1970s airbrush portrait + circular rainbow motif + surreal flora + extended geometric typography
